name: API Direct
description:
Real-time public data from LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Truth Social, Google Search, Google Maps, news sites, forums, Amazon and Trustpilot, through one REST API with one API key.

## Authentication

Send your API key in the `X-API-Key` header on every request. Create a free account at [apidirect.io](https://apidirect.io/signup?utm_source=openapi), then copy a key from [the dashboard](https://apidirect.io/dashboard/keys).

## Pricing

Pay per request with no subscription. Every endpoint has a monthly free tier, and each operation below lists its price. See [Pricing](https://apidirect.io/docs/pricing).

## Errors

Every error is JSON with an HTTP status, a human-readable `error` and a machine-readable `code`, for example `{"error": "Missing API key", "code": "missing_api_key"}`. Retry 502, 503 and 504 responses, and 429 `concurrency_limit_exceeded` or `upstream_rate_limit`, with exponential backoff. See [Error Handling](https://apidirect.io/docs/error-handling).

## Limits

Up to 10 concurrent requests per endpoint per account; requests to different endpoints are counted separately. Use `POST /v1/batch` to run up to 100 calls in one request. See [Rate Limits](https://apidirect.io/docs/rate-limits).
